en: ...Ugh! This wind is fierce!!

jp: 本当にこれでよかったのかな？
ヨハネを待っていた方が
en: Was this really right? Maybe I should have waited for Johannes... But...
Do you remember, Matia?

jp: ボクが突然熱を出して
en: A long time ago, when I suddenly came down with a fever and collapsed.

jp: ボクは、あとから神父様に
en: I heard about it from the Father afterwards.

jp: キミはボクを背負って
夜の道を月明かりを頼りに
教会まで運んでくれたんだ
en: You carried me on your back, by moonlight, all the way to the church.

jp: すごくぼんやりとしか
en: ...I only remember that time very hazily, but...

jp: ・・・でも、覚えているんだ
en: ...But I do remember.

jp: ボクの名を呼ぶキミの声を
en: Your voice, calling my name.

jp: ずっと握っていてくれた
en: The warmth of your hand, holding mine the whole way.

jp: ボクはあの日のことを
en: Whatever happens, I don't think I'll ever forget that day.

jp: 今度は、ボクの番だからね
en: This time it's my turn, Matia.

jp: こんなところで会うとは
en: Fancy meeting you in a place like this, eh?
You!?
The little lady on your back's white as a sheet, isn't she?
Let me give you a hand.
Like hell!!

jp: 素直に受け取っておくものだぜ？
en: Kukuku. You should accept a kind offer graciously, you know?
...Gahh!!

jp: ま、今日はそのけなげさに免じて
拳一つで勘弁してやるよ
en: Well, in honor of that touching devotion, I'll let you off with one punch today.
......Ugh! W-wait!!

jp: お姫様はもらっていくぜ♪
en: See ya. I'll be taking the princess with me.
Wait!! Give Matia back!!
HYAA-HAHAHA!

jp: うぅ・・・カイン・・・
en: Ugh... Cain...

jp: ＜生けにえ＞も見つかったことだ
もう、この島にも用はねぇな・・
en: Now then. Found the sacrifice, so I've got no more business on this island...

jp: ちっ、嫌な風だぜ・・・
en: Tch. Nasty wind...

jp: 招かれざる客が現れるには
もってこいの演出だけどな
en: Perfect staging for an uninvited guest to show up, though.

jp: いい加減に、出てこいよ・・・
いるのはわかってるんだぜ？
en: Come out already... I know you're there.
You are Aragi, I take it?
Hmm...

jp: 毛色の変わった天使を
飼い始めたじゃねぇか
en: So the Church has started keeping some pretty odd-looking angels, has it?
No, wait... Don't tell me you're...!!
Remember it well...

jp: ベイル・ペレンデール
それが、お前を殺す者の名前だ
en: Bale Perendale. That is the name of the one who will kill you.
...Matia's gone.

jp: ボクはどうすればいい？
en: What do I do?

jp: 神父様に言えば、何かきっと
en: That's right, the church... If I tell the Father, surely something...
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
